fun plan() {
  val planTools = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val dimension = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/dimension.txt")
  val rubric = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/rubric.md")
  val pr = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val repoReadme = read_repo_file(".repo_context/README.md")
  val repoIndex = read_repo_file(".repo_context/index.md")
  val repoMaintenance = read_repo_file(".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val generatedIndex = read_repo_file(".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val engineeringPrinciples = read_repo_file(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val testsReproduction = read_repo_file(".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
  val review = compute(planTools, dimension, rubric, pr, diff, taskContext, repoReadme, repoIndex, repoMaintenance, generatedIndex, engineeringPrinciples, testsReproduction)
  write_file("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", review)
  publish("safeoutputs/noop", "No action needed: correctness review evidence was written locally with no actionable findings.")
}
